scientific_integrity: The complete global-mode and critical-onset claims are given with analytical proofs and independent finite numerical checks. Numerical sampling is not represented as a proof; no external audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Ideal one-dimensional two-velocity harmonic confinement with a constant flip rate, fixed self-propulsion speed, independent additive thermal Brownian motion and strictly positive thermal variance. The onset expansion is pointwise in fixed 0<a<1, not uniform near a=0 or a=1; it does not establish dynamic relaxation laws or higher-dimensional radial effects. Known convolution and curvature-equation results are attributed to their earlier sources. General heat-flow modality theory could independently contain implicit coverage.
title: A unique thermal-mode transition and universal peak splitting for a harmonically confined run-and-tumble particle
